description.value: Hilton Vancouver Metrotown is a full-service, 4-star hotel with 283 rooms situated in Burnaby's Metrotown district, one of Metro Vancouver's major urban centres. The property carries the Hilton brand flag, includes a bar on-site, and is wheelchair accessible. Its location adjacent to Metrotown Station makes it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists navigating the Greater Vancouver urban corridor.
